query:
SELECT
                id                       AS "id!: Uuid",
                name                     AS "name!",
                active                   AS "active!",
                created_at               AS "created_at!: DateTime<Utc>",
                price_per_meal::float8   AS "price_per_meal?: f64"
            FROM recipe
            WHERE LOWER(name) = LOWER($1) AND active = TRUE
